issue: The recorded age is 46, but inclusion criterion INCL01 requires patients to be at least 50 years old.
query_text: The demographics record shows this patient's age as 46 years. Inclusion criterion INCL01 requires males and postmenopausal females to be at least 50 years of age. The patient was dosed from 2012-10-24. Please check the recorded date of birth and age. If the age is correct, please confirm whether an eligibility deviation or waiver was documented.

issue: The screening vitamin B12 was below the reference range, which exclusion criterion EXCL28 does not allow, but the patient was randomised.
query_text: The central laboratory vitamin B12 result at Screening 1 (2012-10-14) was 140.9 pmol/L, below the reference range of 148–664 pmol/L. Exclusion criterion EXCL28 excludes patients whose central laboratory vitamin B12 is below the reference range. Please confirm whether a repeat B12 result within range was obtained before the first dose on 2012-10-24. If not, please confirm whether an eligibility deviation was documented.

issue: There are two APPLICATION SITE ERYTHEMA records with the same dates but different outcomes, and one of them has an end date while its outcome says not recovered.
query_text: Two adverse event records report APPLICATION SITE ERYTHEMA. Both are mild and probably related, with start 2012-11-06 and end 2012-12-13. Record AE:01-708-1216:4 gives the outcome as RECOVERED/RESOLVED. Record AE:01-708-1216:2 gives NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED even though it has an end date. Please confirm whether these are two separate events or a duplicate entry. Please also correct the end date and/or outcome so that they agree.

issue: The patient discontinued because of an adverse event, but no AE record has an action taken, and two AEs are still open after the AE follow-up visit.
query_text: The disposition record dated 2012-12-06 (Week 6) gives ADVERSE EVENT as the reason for discontinuation, and the last dose was on 2012-11-29. However, action taken is blank on all four adverse event records. Please state which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation and complete the action taken (for example, drug withdrawn) on those records. In addition, APPLICATION SITE PRURITUS (start 2012-11-06) and APPLICATION SITE SWELLING (start 2012-11-22) have no end date and an outcome of NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED. An AE follow-up visit took place on 2013-01-09. Please update their outcomes and end dates, if known, as of that visit.
